Dev of infra on linkedin
E2E dev experience and infra for humans and agents. Microsoft use cases and massive scale.

250 to 350 base

---

**Team Name: Development Infrastructure (Developer Infrastructure)**

**Summary of the Role & Scope of Work**

This team is responsible for building the next generation of LinkedIn's Developer Infrastructure platform, enabling more than 10,000 engineers today—and eventually Microsoft engineering teams as well—to build, test, deploy, and operate software faster and more efficiently. The organization owns the complete developer lifecycle, including source code management, build systems, dependency management, testing, deployment, and orchestration, while also reimagining how AI agents will participate in the software development process.

This is a highly strategic Systems & Infrastructure role that sits at the intersection of **Developer Infrastructure, AI Systems, and Large-Scale Distributed Systems**. Engineers on this team are designing and rebuilding foundational platforms from the ground up, including next-generation build toolchains, dependency management systems, orchestration frameworks, workflow engines, and compute infrastructure that power software development across LinkedIn and Microsoft.

The work spans both **greenfield innovation and modernization of existing platforms**, requiring engineers who can architect large-scale systems, influence technical strategy, and drive industry-leading developer productivity. This is not an application development role—it is focused on building the underlying infrastructure that enables thousands of engineers (and AI agents) to develop software more efficiently at hyperscale.

---

**Primary Areas of Responsibility**

- Architect and build next-generation developer infrastructure powering code discovery, build, test, deployment, and developer workflows.
- Design large-scale distributed systems that improve developer productivity across LinkedIn and Microsoft engineering organizations.
- Modernize and rebuild core development tooling including build systems, dependency management, orchestration frameworks, and execution platforms.
- Develop infrastructure supporting both human developers and AI agents throughout the software development lifecycle.
- Drive architectural direction for highly scalable workflow, compute, and distributed processing systems.
- Improve software development velocity by reducing build times, simplifying workflows, and automating engineering processes.
- Influence engineering strategy across multiple organizations while contributing to industry standards and open-source projects.

---

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The strongest candidates combine **Developer Infrastructure expertise with large-scale Systems & Infrastructure experience**.

Ideal candidates have experience building:

- Developer Infrastructure platforms (Bazel, Gradle, build systems, compiler infrastructure, dependency management)
- Large-scale distributed systems
- Workflow and orchestration engines
- Compute orchestration and scheduling platforms
- Runtime or execution platforms
- Cloud infrastructure and large-scale compute systems
- Service platforms supporting thousands of engineers
- Graph-based dependency management or data lineage platforms

Candidates should demonstrate:

- Strong systems design from first principles
- Deep hands-on technical leadership
- Experience managing large codebases and build ecosystems
- Expertise operating production infrastructure at hyperscale
- Ability to influence technical strategy across organizations
- Passion for developer productivity and platform engineering
